name: still-mods
description: Personal mods for Claude Code: plan progress bars, context, 5-hour and weekly usage meters, and an Agents pane

planProgress.title: Plan progress bars
planProgress.description: Progress bars for multi-step tasks, with the plan_progress tool and the /progress commands

planEnforcement.title: Plan bar enforcement
planEnforcement.description: strict: refuse changes and send the turn back until the bar is updated; soft: reminders from the 2nd change, repeated while no bar is open, and recalled at the next prompt, nothing refused; off: bars only when Claude finds them useful

sounds.title: Sounds
sounds.description: Sounds when a bar waits for a decision, fails or finishes: soft (still-mods' own), classic (plan-progress'), or off

agentsPane.title: Agents pane
agentsPane.description: The subagents of the session and the team journal: auto opens it when an agent starts, manual with /still-mods-agents, off

agentsSessionsDir.title: Team session folders
agentsSessionsDir.description: Folder of the team's session folders, from the project root; the newest one's journal.md is shown. Empty, or a project without it: no session header and no journal

turnNotify.title: End-of-turn notice
turnNotify.description: A sound and a toast with the time and cost when a turn of the main thread ran longer than turnNotifySeconds; the decision sound when a call waits on your approval

turnNotifySeconds.title: End-of-turn threshold (s)
turnNotifySeconds.description: How long a turn must run before its end is notified

gitStatus.title: Git status line
gitStatus.description: The branch, the changed and new files, and ahead/behind its upstream, on the status line under the prompt

usageMeters.title: Usage meters
usageMeters.description: Context, 5-hour and weekly limit meters at the bottom of the band

cacheMeter.title: Cache column
cacheMeter.description: A Cache column in the meters: the share of the last response's input the prompt cache served, and the time the cache has left

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: How long the prompt cache lives after a response: 1h or 5m

timeZone.title: Reset time zone
timeZone.description: IANA time zone for the 5-hour reset time, such as Europe/Paris

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: Colours of the bars and meters, from popular editor themes (the app's own colours do not change)

language.title: Language
language.description: Labels' language: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale
